blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas men ended their pool campaign in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 with a heartbreaking 25-21, 20-25, 17-25, 27-29 loss to Chinese Taipei on Tuesday at Park Arena Komaki. After taking the opening set convincingly, Alas lost steam as Chinese Taipei dominated the next two and carried the momentum into the fourth with a 19-16 lead. Bryan Bagunas, who was an MVP and champion in Taiwan before he returned to Japan, took matters into his own hands, scoring four straight for a 21-20 Alas lead. […]...
